[NDBG.1.3] **Pointer lifetimes split two ways.** Callback-based enumerators
(`rete_network`, `rete_match_trace`, `refracted_activations`) pass strings valid
**only for the callback's duration** — copy what you keep. Inside such a
callback, every call on the engine being enumerated returns `DS_ERR_STATE`
([RARC.13.17]); act on what you copied after the enumerator returns. View accessors
(`rule_meta`, `line_span`, `ds_source`, the `ds_schema_get_*` family) return
**engine-owned, engine-lifetime** borrows. `ds_engine_get_justifiers` is the
exception that allocates **caller-owned** arrays ([NDBG.5]).
